# RT

> RT is a 24/7 global news network providing international coverage with a Russian perspective on world events, conflicts, and geopolitics across multiple languages and platforms.

RT operates as a multilingual news organization covering breaking news, geopolitical analysis, and international affairs with dedicated channels in English, Russian, Spanish, French, German, and Arabic. The network provides news distribution through live streams, mobile applications, RSS feeds, and an educational academy.

## Key Topics

- Russia-Ukraine conflict
- Iran-Israel tensions
- Middle East conflict
- Geopolitical analysis
- Breaking news
- International news
- Live updates
- Putin
- NATO
- Ukraine
- Iran
- Israel
- United States
- India
- Africa

## Main News Platforms

- [RT - Breaking News, Russia News, World News and Video](https://www.rt.com): RT homepage - 24/7 English news channel with Russian perspective on global events
- [RT News — RT](https://www.rt.com/on-air): RT live news stream with 24/7 international headlines and global coverage
- [World news — RT International](https://www.rt.com/news): RT world news with breaking updates on global conflicts and international politics

## Multilingual News Channels

- [RT на русском: последние новости в России и в мире онлайн](https://russian.rt.com): RT Russian language news portal with daily updates on politics and world events
- [RT en Español - Noticias internacionales](https://actualidad.rt.com): RT Spanish international news covering Iran-Israel tensions and breaking news
- [RT en français — Actualités internationales](https://francais.rt.com): RT French international news covering Middle East and geopolitical tensions
- [RT DE](https://de.rt.com): RT German language news covering Ukraine conflict and Middle East tensions
- [RT Arabic](https://arabic.rt.com): RT Arabic news channel covering Middle East conflicts and geopolitical analysis

## Regional & Topic Coverage

- [Russia-Ukraine conflict — RT](https://www.rt.com/trends/russia-ukraine-conflict): RT coverage of Russia-Ukraine war including military operations and negotiations
- [Russia news - RT International](https://www.rt.com/russia): RT Russia news covering economy, politics and geopolitical developments
- [Business news — RT International](https://www.rt.com/business): RT business coverage including energy markets, sanctions and global trade
- [India — RT International](https://www.rt.com/india): RT India news covering geopolitics, energy security and regional developments
- [Africa — RT International](https://www.rt.com/africa): RT Africa news with regional coverage and geopolitical analysis

## News Distribution & Syndication

- [RT RSS news feeds for World News, US news, UK News, and sport news](https://www.rt.com/rss-feeds): RT RSS feeds for news syndication across multiple categories and languages
- [Applications — RT](https://www.rt.com/applications): RT mobile news apps for Android, iOS and Windows platforms
- [Where to watch — RT](https://www.rt.com/where-to-watch): RT channel availability guide for global regions and broadcast locations
- [Schedule — RT](https://www.rt.com/schedule): RT broadcast schedule and programming guide for news and documentary shows

## Education & Media Resources

- [RT Academy](https://academy.rt.com): RT Academy journalism education program offering international courses and training
- [Новости ИноТВ — РТ на русском](https://russian.rt.com/inotv): InoTV international media aggregation and foreign press coverage in Russian

## Optional

- [Entertainment — RT International](https://www.rt.com/pop-culture): RT entertainment news covering pop culture, film, music and celebrity stories
